kind: Prospective managed-polling mechanism cycle on one known diagnostic; no F72 model dispatch

hypothesis.mechanism: For an incremental inspect with no new output on an owned running command, wait for new output, process termination or at most 30 seconds. Omit the cursor for an immediate snapshot. Preserve command timeout/cancellation, SDK loop guard and finalized-result publication.
hypothesis.evidence: F70 1-fetching-filters-reference and 1-fetching-filters-source-order abort at iterations 23/27 after five identical cursor inspections; their required regression process was last reported running. The source-order patch passes every independent endpoint.
hypothesis.measure: Actual SDK loop-guard termination, inspections per invocation, completed required final-source executions and strict audited success; then all-assigned and jointly-successful tokens/cost/duration.
hypothesis.comparison: Current Light including the separate F71 finalized-result correction, with waiting disabled versus enabled; integrated Cline unchanged. Other Light flags are common.
hypothesis.regressionRisk: An incremental inspection can wait longer while a command is quiet. New output, timeout and cancellation must wake it; cursors must remain byte offsets, no fabricated progress, no command relaunch and no synthetic validation.
